senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; קָרָה I a. II) town, settlement, fort. Lam. R. introd. (R. Naḥman) (ref. to Is. XXIX, 1) ק׳ שחנה וכ׳ the town in which David put up his camp; ק׳ דלא חניא וכ׳ the place where &c., v. חַנְיָא.
units: <cite ref="Isaiah 29:1">Ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ שעשה וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S01684"><he>קְסִרְקִיטוֹן</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 302">Yalk. Is. 302</cite>. Tanḥ. K’dosh. 9 <he>מעשה היה בקִרְיָתֵנוּ</he> it happened in our place; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24">Lev. R. s. 24</cite>, beg. <he>בקרתני</he> (corr. acc.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 680:3">Yalk. Ps. 680</cite> <he>בעירנו</he>).—Pl. <he>קִרְיוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:8">Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>מעשה … ק׳ וכ׳</he> it happened with (representatives of) 24 townships belonging to the house of Rabbi, that they were assembled to proclaim an intercalation at Lydda.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 9:5:3">Y. B. Bath. IX, 17ᵃ</cite> <he>קריות</he>, read <he>קרנות</he>, v. <cite ref="S01951"><he>קָרוֹן</he></cite>.]
